name: Blazing Hippogryph and X-53 Touring Rocket fly with a real speed aura where flying is allowed (#10460)
contract: Blazing Hippogryph (spell 74856, item 54069) and X-53 Touring Rocket (spell 75973, item 54860), both Recruit
a Friend rewards, cast SPELL_EFFECT_SCRIPT_EFFECT wrapper spells with no speed aura of their own: the client
resolves the real mount through a Mount Journal the 3.3.5a client does not have. AscensionCollectibles::
MountWrappers maps every other mount wrapper spell to its real Ground60/Ground100/Flying150/280/310 variant
ids so spell_ascension_local_mount can select one; these two were missing, so casting them only applied
SPELL_AURA_MOUNTED with no speed boost ("you must be mounted to do that").
The fix wires the Flying150/280/310 fields to the real client spells carrying the mount's actual
for the Rocket), letting the mount apply a real speed aura at Expert riding (225) or above where flying is
allowed, exactly like every other flying entry in the table.
Both of the real client spells for the Hippogryph, and the two higher tiers for the Rocket, carry
SPELL_ATTR4_ONLY_FLYING_AREAS, so SpellInfo::CheckLocation requires Player::canFlyInZone before either
spell can even be cast; the client DBC ships no ground-only variant of either mount without that attribute.
Ground60/Ground100 are therefore left at 0: below Expert riding, or anywhere flying is not allowed (such as
the reporter's Stormwind), both mounts still cast with no visible effect, same as before this fix. Fixing
that remaining gap needs a custom ground-only spell clone (the same pattern already used for other table
entries, e.g. spell 498669 for the Golden Gryphon), which is not present in the available client DBC data.

steps.label: the rider knows the Blazing Hippogryph wrapper
below Expert riding still gives no mount (the known ground-use gap)
Artisan riding gives 100% ground speed, not just SPELL_AURA_MOUNTED
Artisan riding in Outland allows flying
the rider knows the X-53 Touring Rocket wrapper
Artisan riding mounts the rider on the Rocket
the Rocket allows flying at Artisan riding in Outland
